mainTitle: 🔧 Structural Failures - Part 2: Correction Proposals and Reform
mainDescription: Continuation of the analysis and correction proposals — This article continues the analysis of structural failures in Lusophone Wikipedia governance and presents concrete correction and reform proposals to prevent new abuses, restore digital democracy and ensure user protection.
section1Title: 1. Introduction: The Need for Structural Reform
section1Text1: The analysis of Lusophone Wikipedia's structural failures (Part 1) revealed a deeply dysfunctional system that enables power abuses, institutional persecution and impunity. This second part presents concrete correction and reform proposals, based on the identified failures and best practices in digital governance.
objective1: • Propose concrete solutions for each identified failure
warningUrgencyText: Structural reform is not an option — it is an urgent necessity. Every day without reform is a day when new users can fall victim to the same system of institutional persecution that affected WazzimaGiygg.

adminReformTable.correction: Separation of administrative and verification functions
adminReformTable.implementation: Administrators cannot be checkusers; checkusers cannot be administrators

adminReformTable.correction: Establishment of fixed term with limited renewal
adminReformTable.implementation: Maximum term of 2 years, with possibility of a single renewal
Administrators elected in open and transparent community vote
After 2 years, the administrator must step away for at least 1 year

supervisionReformTable.implementation: Appointment of 7 members (4 from community + 3 administrators) with 2-year term
At least 50% of ArbCom members must be non-administrators
Direct WMF oversight over ArbCom and administrative actions
Annual governance review by independent third parties

procedureReformTable.correction: Guarantee of the right to defense
procedureReformTable.implementation: The user must have at least 48 hours to present defense before any sanction
Every accusation must be accompanied by documented evidence
Reformed ArbCom with power to review all administrative decisions
No sanction may be applied in less than 48 hours (except in proven emergency cases)

dataProtectionTable.correction: Explicit prohibition of personal data exposure
dataProtectionTable.implementation: Strict data protection policy with penalties for violations
Implementation of privacy policies in compliance with LGPD
IP data must be deleted within 90 days (per global policy)
Prohibition of collecting IMEI, MAC Address and other physical identifiers

pm1Text: 7 members (4 from community + 3 administrators) with 2-year term
pm2Text: External Ethics Committee with review power
pm5Text: Administrators must step away after 2 years
pm7Text: Full compliance with LGPD and global policies
controlMechanisms: Peer control: Administrators review other administrators' actions.
Community control: The community can participate in important decisions.
External control: Oversight by the Wikimedia Foundation and independent audit.
Legal control: Compliance with Brazilian legislation (LGPD, Marco Civil).
Ethical control: Strict Code of Ethics with penalties for violations.
accountabilityCulture: Individual responsibility: Each administrator must answer for their actions.
Communicational transparency: Open and honest communication with the community.
Error recognition: Ability to admit and correct mistakes.
Continuous learning: Learning from mistakes to prevent future abuses.
respectCulture: Respect for the community: Treat all users with dignity and respect.
Empathy: Understand the impact of actions on users' lives.
Valuing diversity: Include diverse voices in governance.
transparencyCulture: Open decisions: All decisions must be justified and public.
Accessible data: Governance information must be accessible to the community.

implementationTable.actions: Demotion of involved agents, ArbCom reactivation, removal of personal data
Implementation of new policies, administrator training, creation of complaint channels
Implementation of the reformed governance model, independent audit
Cultural change, continuous training, monitoring and evaluation

responsibleParties: Wikimedia Foundation: Global oversight, intervention when necessary.
Community: Active participation in the reform process.
Independent Audit: Monitoring and evaluation of implementation.
Legal Authorities: Criminal and civil investigation and accountability.
earlyWarning: Pattern monitoring: Identification of repeated abuse patterns (like the "Little Sunshine" pattern).
Anonymous complaints: Secure channel for abuse complaints.
Behavioral analysis: Identification of suspicious administrator behavior.
Periodic assessment: Regular review of administrative actions.
abuseConsequences: Legal penalties: Criminal and civil actions against abusers.
Structural penalties: Reform of mechanisms that enabled abuse.

legalReformTable.device: LGPD Art. 6 - Good faith and transparency

legalReformTable.foundation: Guarantee of adversarial proceedings and full defense

callToActionList: Immediate Implementation: Immediate adoption of emergency measures.
Administrative Reform: Implementation of all structural reform proposals.
Cultural Change: Promotion of a culture of accountability, respect and transparency.
Community Participation: Active community involvement in the reform process.
WMF Oversight: Intervention by the Wikimedia Foundation to ensure implementation.
Independent Audit: Monitoring and evaluation of implementation.
Legal Accountability: Criminal and civil actions against abusive agents.
finalText1: The WazzimaGiygg case exposed deep structural failures in Lusophone Wikipedia governance. The proposed reform offers a concrete path to correct these failures and prevent future abuses.
finalText2: The reform proposals — power decentralization, supervision reactivation, due process guarantee, data protection, cultural change — create a new governance model based on transparency, accountability, community participation and respect for fundamental rights.
finalText3: The implementation of these reforms is urgent and necessary. Without them, Lusophone Wikipedia will continue to be an instrument of institutional persecution, rather than the model of digital democracy it should be.
